fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Extract data from cab file and hide it in an alternate data stream
fields.name: Suspicious Extrac32 Alternate Data Stream Execution
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "extrac32.exe" and tgt.process.cmdline contains ".cab") and tgt.process.cmdline matches ":[^\\\\]"))
